free_text: The statistical prior suggested no biopsy (p=0.34), which was overturned by the retrieved evidence showing a clear rising PSA trend (5.3 -> 7.7 ng/mL) and the established prior diagnosis of ISUP Grade Group 1 carcinoma. The guideline criterion abstained because the panel did not settle the case, leaving the decision to the retrieved documents. Since no retrieved document explicitly stated a reason to proceed with biopsy (like an undocumented grade or changed lesion), the decision defaults to deferral, despite the rising PSA.
